title: Zesty Gooey Argentinian Provolone Empanadas
description: A savory Argentinian dish featuring gooey provolone cheese and umami flavors, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe incorporates shichimi-togarashi and deglaze for added depth.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a bowl, mix together shredded provolone cheese, diced red onion, and diced red bell pepper.
Place a spoonful of the cheese mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of shichimi-togarashi over the cheese mixture.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the empanadas are baking, heat the balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat until reduced and syrupy.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and brush the reduced balsamic glaze over the tops.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
